title: HSG-12M: A Large-Scale Benchmark of Spatial Multigraphs from the Energy Spectra of Non-Hermitian Crystals

split.decision: std3: materialize original stratified 80/10/10 split once with seed 42, including original Numba rebalancing order; train 158995, val 19874, test 19875. Opaque random ids; private source-index map. Training BENCH_SEED 1/2/3 maps to original 42/2025/666, independent of the fixed data split.

baseline.paper_ref: Reproduced metric mean accuracy 0.8523102725366876; seeds 42/2025/666; 703080 parameters.

allowed_changes: GNN or other classification architecture, learned feature processing, surrogate loss, optimizer and training strategy within the same capacity/work controls.
fixed_contract: Maximize one-band spatial-multigraph Top-1 accuracy under the original controlled capacity and training-work budgets.
Fixed graph inputs/features, 24 Hamiltonian classes, supplied split and from-scratch fitting/data-use rules.
At most floor(1.04*703080)=731203 real trainable parameters, 1000 optimizer updates across all ranks and 100 started epochs.
Original micro accuracy, three-seed aggregation and validation-based checkpoint selection.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: The 1,000 limit counts updates to the fitted model across all ranks: a synchronized DDP step counts once, and asynchronous, local-update or separately trained workers each add their own updates to the total.
Increasing model capacity or training-work budget to replace the controlled comparison.
Using hidden/external labels or pretrained weights, changing graph inputs/labels or the scoring objective.
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.
